notes:
Ordrili 1.6.12
- Pricing: the chef board and queue board are included in every plan; add-ons have one flat price per period and renew together with your subscription.
- Menu: import a whole menu from photos or a PDF; a guided item form (3 steps, a publish checklist, AI that previews before it fills); save a dish as a draft with just a name and a category.
- Quick notes: tap-chips for common kitchen requests ("No mayo") on every ordering screen and on tickets.
- Cancel reasons: add your own and hide the ones you don't use.
- Printing: auto-print tickets after an order or a payment; reprint a payment ticket from Payment History; restaurants choose whether kiosk customers can print.
- Order details: one card per round with a clear header, and the total shown once.
- Arabic: better translation, left/right wording that matches each language, and Arabic customer names no longer print as "???".
- Safety: Hub and cloud hardening; a lapsed add-on or licence never unpairs a kiosk or tablet.
